extracted.name: Apple Crisp in a Mug
extracted.description: This apple crisp in a mug recipe is an easy, delicious, no-fuss or muss treat. The crisp-tender apples pair well with the buttery crumble topping.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 apple - peeled, cored, and thinly sliced
instruction_lines: Combine butter and white sugar in a bowl using your fingers; add flour, oats, 1 pinch cinnamon, and salt. Mix until crumbly.
Grease a microwave-safe mug. Place ½ oat crumble mixture in the mug; press to form a crust.
Microwave crust on high for 30 seconds.
Add apple slices, brown sugar, and 1 pinch cinnamon to the mug; add water and mix together carefully without disturbing bottom crust. Pour remaining ½ oat crumble mixture on top.
Microwave on 60 percent power for 1 minute 50 seconds. Cool before serving, about 1 minute.
